title: Farmslot Mobile Companion recipe evidence review smoke
description: Validates the Mobile Companion run detail, decision/evidence review, recipe-run selector, artifact cards, and media viewer surfaces.

open-run-detail.intent: Open the selected run detail screen in the Mobile Companion app.

select-recipe-run.intent: Select a recipe-run chip so artifacts are scoped to the attempted or promoted recipe run.

open-recipe-artifacts.intent: Open recipe artifacts from the run detail screen and verify recipe-run scoped URLs are used.

assert-evidence-review.intent: Verify decision/evidence review cards show screenshots, reports, logs, and recipe artifacts with consistent labels.

capture-mobile-artifacts.intent: Record the Mobile Companion artifact viewer with the selected recipe-run evidence visible.

index-artifacts.intent: Publish the mobile navigation report and log; the screenshot is already registered by its capture action.
